definitions.explanation: A regular occasion for eating, or the food served at such a time.

{食事|しょくじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧です。
⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{食事|しょくじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I had a meal together with my family.
Let's wash our hands before the meal.

examples.english: I have plans to eat out with a friend today, so I want to finish work early.

notes:
{食事|しょくじ} refers to meals or the act of eating. Also functions as a suru-verb.

MEAL TYPES (formal):
- {朝食|ちょうしょく}: breakfast
- {昼食|ちゅうしょく}: lunch
- {夕食|ゆうしょく}: dinner/supper

CASUAL EQUIVALENTS:
- {朝|あさ}ご{飯|はん}: breakfast
- {昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}: lunch
- {晩|ばん}ご{飯|はん}/{夕|ゆう}ご{飯|はん}: dinner

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {食事|しょくじ}をする: to have a meal
- {食事|しょくじ}に{行|い}く: to go out to eat
- {食事|しょくじ}{中|ちゅう}: during a meal
- {食事|しょくじ}{制限|せいげん}: dietary restrictions
